verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any extended-thinking mode, reasoning-effort level, or confidence-signal parameter for Llama. The only parameter-related item (llama-docs-17) covers sampling temperature and top-p. Those are adjacent sampling controls, not control over how hard the model reasons, and they also depend on the serving implementation.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can control how hard the model thinks — extended reasoning/thinking modes, effort levels, or confidence signals — through documented request parameters
